# OpenATS

> OpenATS is an open-source applicant tracking system for teams that want a clear, adaptable hiring process and ownership of their hiring data.

## About

- Website: https://openats.dev/
- Source code: https://github.com/chamals3n4/OpenATS
- License: Apache License 2.0
- Live demo: https://demo.openats.dev/

## Documentation

- What is OpenATS?: https://openats.dev/docs/intro
- Quick Start: https://openats.dev/docs/getting-started/make-setup
- Manual setup: https://openats.dev/docs/getting-started/quick-start
- Architecture: https://openats.dev/docs/developer/architecture
- Using OpenATS: https://openats.dev/docs/using-openats/jobs-and-candidates
- Testing: https://openats.dev/docs/developer/testing
- Contributing Guide: https://openats.dev/docs/developer/contributing

## Product scope

OpenATS supports job management, candidate tracking, interview coordination, hiring-team collaboration, AI-assisted resume parsing, and branded career pages. It uses WSO2 Identity Platform for authentication, PostgreSQL for persistent data, Redis and BullMQ for background work, and an S3-compatible storage provider for resumes and attachments.

For the complete, long-form documentation index, see https://openats.dev/llms-full.txt.
